lines.en: Wings flap, a whisper in the sky.
Soar among clouds, where prey is?
Swoop by, a low hum in wind.
Seek prey in flight, scent guides.
Loaded with ammo, I skim past the chimneys.

lines.zh: 无烟煤的粉末从我翼下洒落。
lines.en: Anthracite dust sifts from beneath my wings.

lines.zh: 我在树冠上方慢慢盘旋。
lines.en: I circle slowly above the treetops.
Pause in sky, wait for chance.

lines.zh: 我在云里盘旋，清点弹药。
lines.en: I circle in the clouds and count my rounds.

lines.zh: 我从天上带下来一箱弹药。
lines.en: I bring a crate of ammo down from the sky.
Player to the side, strike now.
I'm in the air. You can't reach me.
Player in front, ready to strike.
Player to the side, strike quick.

lines.zh: 你似乎对我产生了兴趣？

lines.en: I'm not that easy to take down.
I'm airborne. You can't reach me.
Toss up the ammo in your hand.

lines.zh: 你的头撞歪了我的螺旋桨。

lines.en: Don't stand on my landing spot.
You irritated me with your collision.

lines.zh: 我在天上飞，找同频的同伴。
lines.en: I fly high, seeking a mate on my frequency.
You're a good mate for me.

lines.zh: 我不会让别人占我位置。

lines.en: Two carriers take to the air together.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇动着沉重的无烟煤尘。
lines.en: Wings flap, kicking up coal dust.

lines.zh: 翅膀带着暗金色的光泽。
翅膀下的阴影笼罩着你。
翅膀轻轻滑动，掠过地面。
我从天上往下看得很清楚。
lines.en: From up here, I see you clearly.

lines.zh: 目标进入视野，准备突袭。
lines.en: Target in sight, preparing to strike.

lines.zh: 弹壳落地的声音，我听见了。
lines.en: I caught the ring of a spent casing.

lines.zh: 你在下面开枪，我在上面看。
lines.en: You fire below; I watch from above.
Those rounds you carry? Mine now.

lines.zh: 翅膀一斜，就往你那儿去。
lines.en: One wingtip dips and I bank toward you.

lines.zh: 地面的火器，压不住天空。
lines.en: Guns on the ground can't hold the sky.

lines.zh: 弹链过了一遍，没有卡壳。
lines.en: I check the belt; no jam.
Aim at target, prepare to attack.
The wind shifted; I correct half a degree.

lines.zh: 瞄准猎物，准备一击毙命。
lines.en: Aim at prey, ready to kill.

lines.zh: 我绕到你背后，收起翅膀。
lines.en: I circle behind you and fold my wings.
Aim at enemy, prepare to charge.

lines.zh: 机翼下的枪口已经亮起。
lines.en: The muzzle under my wing lights up.
I aim from above; don't look up.

lines.zh: 你的影子在下面，我不会丢。
lines.en: Your shadow is below; I won't lose it.
You're too slow raising that gun.

lines.zh: 别躲树下，我会贴着树飞。
lines.en: Don't hide under trees; I fly between them.
I wheel just above your sights.
How many rounds are left in that magazine?

lines.zh: 我把阴影投在你的脚边。
lines.en: I cast my shadow at your feet.
The wind pushes at my back — perfect.

lines.zh: 你换弹的空当，就是我的。
lines.en: The moment you reload is mine.
Don't look up; I'm directly overhead.
Enough height; I begin my dive.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡得住子弹，挡不住爪。
lines.en: Your armor stops bullets, not talons.

lines.zh: 我绕到你背后的逆光处。
lines.en: I slip behind you into the backlight.
I press down on you from the sky.
I skim low and my rotor clips you.
I skim right past your ear!
A talon rakes the gun from your hands!
My wing bone slams your chest!
I haul you up off the ground!

lines.zh: 俯冲带来的风压得你跪地！
lines.en: The dive's wind pressure drives you to your knees!
Brass feathers scrape across your visor!

lines.zh: 我的喙啄向你的护目镜！
lines.en: My beak jabs at your goggles!

lines.zh: 落地一脚，踩碎你的退路！
lines.en: I land and crush the ground behind you!

lines.zh: 弹药从我的爪间散落一地！
lines.en: Ammo scatters from my talons onto the ground!

lines.zh: 我从云底滑下来，找目标。
lines.en: I slide out from under the clouds, hunting.

lines.zh: 背上这颗弹，是给空中准备的。
lines.en: This round rides on my back for the air.
Gunfire draws me down from high above.

lines.zh: 我从射程外的高处滑进来。
lines.en: I glide in from high ground beyond your range.

lines.zh: 蒙皮烧穿，我闻到了焦味。
lines.en: My skin is burned through; I smell scorch.

lines.zh: 一侧的翼骨先撞上地面。
lines.en: My wing bone hits the ground first.

lines.zh: 羽毛吸饱了水，我飞不动。
lines.en: My feathers are soaked; I can't fly.

lines.zh: 冲击波把我的翅膀掀翻了！
lines.en: The blast folds my wing backward!

lines.zh: 一发子弹打穿了我的翼膜！
lines.en: A round punched through my wing membrane!

lines.zh: 没弹药也没吃的，我发虚。
lines.en: No ammo and no food; I'm running hollow.
Lightning runs down my wing into the gun mount.

lines.zh: 云层下面没有底，我掉了。
lines.en: There is no floor below the clouds; I'm falling.
